  ├───────────┼─────────┼────────────┤
  │ Get       │ O(1)    │ O(n)       │
  ├───────────┼─────────┼────────────┤
  │ Remove    │ O(1)    │ O(n)       │
  └───────────┴─────────┴────────────┘

  Here is a short example using Rust's standard HashMap:

  use std::collections::HashMap;

  fn main() {
      let mut ages: HashMap<&str, u32> = HashMap::new();
      ages.insert("alice", 31);
      ages.insert("bob", 27);

      if let Some(age) = ages.get("alice") {
          println!("alice is {age}");
      }
  }
